description: Single-value range input. Built on the native <input type="range">, so the keyboard contract (arrows, Home/End, Page Up/Down) and screen-reader support come for free; this adds the label row, the value read-out and the themed track. The filled portion is driven by a --pct custom property. Copy: the label carries the unit; the value is announced as the reader would say it, not as a raw number.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the current value at the inline-end of the label row.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats the shown value (e.g. `(v) => `${v}%``). Default is the raw number.
